description: This file is a process monitor implementation written in C. It reads configuration lines specifying process names, their PID files, and restart commands, then checks if those processes are running. If not, it attempts to restart them. It includes functions for process detection, process restarting, and command-line argument parsing.

methods.name: void pmon_usage()
methods.description: Prints usage information for the process monitor.

methods.name: void str_trim(char ** p)
methods.description: Trims leading whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: int find_process(const char * proc_name,const char * pidfile)
methods.description: Searches for a process by name using a PID file; returns 1 if found, 0 otherwise.

methods.name: int proc_mon(const char * proc_name,const char * pid_file,const char * cmd)
methods.description: Checks if a process is active; if not, attempts to restart it using the specified command.
